key_issues_to_review.issue_content: `provision` acquires the repository lock for worktree mode, then discards the release function with `_ = release`. The old code called `defer release()`. Nothing releases the lock now, and the early `return value, nil` for an existing worktree leaks it too. Any later `LockRepository` call on the same project can block indefinitely, including the one this PR adds at the top of `mergeLocal`, unless the lock happens to be re-entrant for the same checkout. Even if it is re-entrant, other checkouts and project operations stay blocked. Restore `defer release()`.

`refreshGitState` no longer sets `BaseSHA` for any worktree-mode workspace. A worktree workspace whose `BaseSHA` is empty for a reason other than an unborn origin (for example, a record created before `BaseSHA` was tracked) will never get one, and the code treats it as unborn-origin. `readCommits` then gets `unbornOrigin=true`, `mergeLocal` takes the `--allow-unrelated-histories` paths, and branch commit stats use the wrong range. I haven't confirmed whether such records exist, so this is uncertain. Tying the skip to a persisted unborn marker would be safer than inferring it from an empty `BaseSHA`.
